api:
<Venn data={users} sets={|u: &Use| u.sets} value={|u: &Use| u.count} />
PropTypeDefault
dataone row per exact combination, such as "A" or "A&B", or one row per itemrequired
setsFn(&T) -> &str: the sets the row belongs torequired
valueFn(&T) -> f641. per row
separatortext between set names"&"
fill_opacityf320.25
legendLegendhidden; names are written next to the circles

Rows with the same combination add up. Circle areas follow the set sizes, and each pair is placed so its overlap area matches the shared count. Up to three sets are exact where circles allow; more sets are placed as close as possible. Each region shows the count of items in exactly that combination.

examples.title: Two sets
examples.description: Circle areas follow set sizes and the overlap follows the shared count.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn two() {
    let data = use_signal(members(&[
        ("Python", 420.),
        ("Rust", 180.),
        ("Python&Rust", 90.),
    ]));
    rsx! { <Venn data={data} sets={|m: &Member| m.sets} value={|m: &Member| m.count} class="h-80" /> }
}

examples.title: Three channels
examples.description: Every region shows its exclusive count.
examples.code:

        ("SMS", 120.),

        ("Email&SMS", 40.),
        ("Push&SMS", 30.),
        ("Email&Push&SMS", 15.),
    ]));
    rsx! { <Venn data={data} sets={|m: &Member| m.sets} value={|m: &Member| m.count} class="h-80" /> }
}
